scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production next build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/public .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -r public/. .next/standalone/public/ && cp -r .next/static/. .next/standalone/.next/static/
scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production sh -c 'if [ -f .next/standalone/server.js ]; then exec node .next/standalone/server.js; else exec node server.js; fi'
